decision.explanation: Both 'Knight Bachelor title' and 'Berliner Kunstpreis' are explicitly mentioned in the provided source texts as awards received by Giselher Klebe. Document D1S1 and related sentences describe the Knight Bachelor title awarded by Queen Elizabeth II, while D2S4 and related sentences detail the Berliner Kunstpreis. These are distinct awards and valid referents. Candidate C2 ('Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany') lacks direct textual support and is marked as uncertain or wrong in the audit.
